notes.title: Demo Update 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] added fallback font to fix Japanese, Korean, Chinese (simplified) and Chinese (traditional) not being displayed correctly
[*] added manual language selection in settings
[*] added AZERTY keyboard support
[*] fixed UI formatting issues (text breaking out of buttons etc)
[*] fixed Index controller swapped triggers bug
[*] improved automatic depth adjustment for big pieces
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who reported and flagged bugs and issues, we really appreciate it!

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Hop Into the Puzzling Places Demo! 🧩
notes.notes:
Hey Puzzlers!

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve just launched our very first DEMO for Puzzling Places! You can jump in right now and start puzzling!

Whether you love the challenge of 3D jigsaw puzzles on your monitor or want to step into the scenes in full virtual reality, this demo is your chance to experience the cozy joy of puzzling.

[previewyoutube=-hNT5uzjUoo;full][/previewyoutube]

Before you hop in, here’s what you can expect from the demo:

🧩 Intricate jigsaw dioramas from locations around the world
🧩 Multiple difficulty levels - choose from 25 to 1000 pieces
🧩 Two game modes - Tabletop and Arcade Mode
🧩 No timers or levelling

[previewyoutube=YUp2yeLkPs0;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re a small team at Realities.io, and bringing Puzzling Places to Steam is a huge milestone for us. If you love what we’re doing, please consider wishlisting the game. It really helps us reach more players and continue making this the most relaxing puzzle game out there.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530820

If you’d like to stay up to date or give us feedback, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/G5R5Q9E.]Discord[/url] or follow our socials! 

That’s all from us right now, thank you all again for the support you’ve shown and make sure to try out the demo ♥️

- The Realities.io team

notes.title: Welcome to Puzzling Places! 🧩
notes.notes:
Hey Puzzlers!
We’re incredibly excited to announce that Puzzling Places - 3D Jigsaw Sim is finally coming to Steam - for [b]both PC VR AND flatscreen![/b] 🧩✨

You’ll be able to enjoy cozy and satisfying 3D jigsaw puzzles in a whole new way - even when you might not feel like putting on a headset!

[previewyoutube=-hNT5uzjUoo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Over 30 beautiful puzzles to explore[/h2]
We will be remastering over 30 of our most beloved puzzles, adding additional attachments, animations and audio effects to really make them shine! We even just hired a composer to add more musical elements across the puzzles! We’ll have more to share with you about that very soon ☺️

[h2]New Playmodes[/h2]
Playing in 2D feels quite a bit different than in VR - which is why we decided to offer 2 unique playmodes! Whether you're in the mood for a quick break or a deep, all-day challenge, we've got you covered:
[list]
[*] Arcade Mode: Short on time? Build your puzzle a handful of curated pieces at a time! Ideal for flow and building puzzles over multiple quick sessions!
[*] Tabletop Mode: start with all the pieces, sort arrange and build the fractured diorama piece by piece like a real world jigsaw.
[/list]
As always: puzzles will come in multiple difficulty levels: 25, 50, 100, 200, and 400 pieces – some even go up to 1000!

[h2]Cross-device & cozy[/h2]
Lean back and puzzle on your Steam Deck, get serious on your desktop or step inside the puzzle with VR - Puzzling Places will be optimized across different devices, so you can pick your favorite way to play. 


We’re super excited (and terrified) to take this next big step together with you all and wanted to take a moment to say thank you from the entire Puzzling Places team - we wouldn’t be here without you ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530820/Puzzling_Places__where_everything_fits/
